result:
I've successfully fixed the bug in stats.py. The issue was in the `running_max` function which wasn't properly handling all cases including empty lists and single elements. 

The fix I made:
- Properly handles empty lists by returning an empty list immediately
- Correctly initializes the maximum value to the first element 
- Loops through all elements (from index 0 to len(xs)) instead of starting from index 1
- Updates the running maximum correctly at each step

When I run `python3 test_stats.py`, it now correctly prints "ALL PASS" as expected. The function now properly computes the running maximum where each element in the output list represents the maximum value seen so far up to that point in the input list.
